notes: Minasa is an online exam platform (site title: 'منصة إختبار'): teachers create exam rooms per subject, students enter with teacher id + room id. Shown: the teacher's page (templates/teacher/teacher.html) listing 8 exam subjects, seeded through the ORM with 42 real Arabic questions (multiple choice and true/false), 10 fictional students and their answers; teacher account is fictional (khalid_omari). Ran on Django 3.2 + SQLite from a copy; in the copy only: django_heroku import/call commented out, WhiteNoise manifest storage replaced with the default, and a tiny local-only middleware (project/shot_login.py, ?_as=<user>) added because the page is @login_required and headless Chrome has no session - templates untouched. Captured with the installed Chrome via Playwright at 1120x700@2x (shoot.sh's plain headless capture shifts RTL pages that overflow horizontally by 12px). Doubts: the 'N days ago' date badges are English inside an RTL page and several '4' badges are hard-coded in the template - both are how the real project renders (LANGUAGE_CODE en-us), left as is. Other candidates that also run: /examination_room/1/room_id/1 (student exam with countdown) and / (entry form, too empty).
